messages:
infra-bot: [ALERT] High network error rate detected for inference instances in us-east-1a. ~18% 5xxs on /v1/generate across multiple hosts. Auto-escalating to #incidents.
alex_s: seeing the spike in grafana. p95 latency also rising. linking sample trace: https://grafana/redwood/trace/abc123
maria_r: confirmed packet drops on host-eni metrics, some kernels showing rx-queue backlog. looks zonal. starting triage.
oncall-l2: I'm oncall, joining. can you dump the list of impacted instance IDs?
eng-runtime: grabbing logs from the serving fleet, will check kvcache errors and connection resets.
alex_s: impacted instances: i-0a12b34c, i-0d56e78f, i-09gh12jk (subset). many show increased retransmits and conn resets.
ops_manager: do we have capacity to shift traffic to other AZs? what's the config for cross-az fallback?
maria_r: yes we have cross-az fallback policy but it's conservative for cold starts. suggestion: enable aggressive cross-az reroute for inference routes for next 15m.
oncall-l2: can we avoid large model reloads when moving traffic? customer SLAs are tight.
eng-runtime: plan: 1) mark hosts draining to stop new model loads 2) change routing weight to route ~80% of traffic to us-east-1b/1c 3) enable deprioritization of non-critical model loads (batch load jobs) 4) trigger dedicated-capacity fallback for enterprise tenants if latency SLI breaches.
alex_s: sample curl showing 502s on a replica:
```
curl -X POST https://inference.us-east-1a.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -v
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
maria_r: executing drain on the three hosts now: kube cordon+drain started. will preserve hot KV cache for warm hosts where possible.
oncall-l2: changing routing weights now to 80/10/10 (1b/1c/hostless) and disabling cold-start model pulls for the next 20m. :arrow_right_hook:
eng-runtime: need a quick toggle pushed to routing service, I'll post the rollback command:
```
# set routing override
POST /admin/routing/override {"region":"us-east-1","weights":{"1a":0.1,"1b":0.8,"1c":0.1}}
# rollback
POST /admin/routing/override {"region":"us-east-1","weights":null}
```
ops_manager: CS, please prepare customer comms for top impacted orgs (list below). target message: brief impact, mitigation in progress, expected next update in 30m.
cs_lead: ACK. drafting short note now. will include mitigation steps and invite customers to join a live status bridge if needed.
alex_s: monitoring p99 and error-rate. so far error-rate dropping from 18% -> 6% after routing change. keeping an eye on model load failures during drainage.
maria_r: still seeing a couple of failed model loads due to image-pull delays; deprioritization helped reduce new loads by ~70%.
oncall-l2: handing off to eng-runtime for continued watch. I'll be available if escalation to infra-hardware is needed.
eng-runtime: taking over. I'll keep traffic override and drains for next 30min and report back every 10min or on change.
cs_lead: sent initial customer notices to top 12 orgs. will update with next status at +30m.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-8301. Severity: SEV2. Pager rotation updated.
eng-runtime: update +10m: error rate down to 2.3%, p95 latency returning to normal. continuing controlled drain.
oncall-l2: great, will re-open if we see regression. thanks all. :thumbsup:
eng-runtime: final update +40m: all drained hosts reprovisioned, traffic weights restored to standard config, monitoring shows stable healthy rates. closing incident in 10m unless new alerts.
ops_manager: please file a follow-up postmortem with root cause (ENI rx-queue) and mitigation steps (softer routing policy, faster deprioritization toggle). assigning to maria_r.
maria_r: will draft the postmortem and include kernel rx-queue tuning and a runbook entry for aggressive cross-az reroute.
cs_lead: prepping customer recap and sending to ops_manager for review.
infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-8301 status: resolved.
_meta: generated for dataset: single Slack thread representing incident coordination, messages in chronological order
